mainImage.alt: Protesters march past the Wisconsin state Capitol holding signs after the police killing of Corey Ruiz
mainImage.caption: Protesters march past the Wisconsin state Capitol on July 23, 2026, in Madison, Wis., after a Madison police officer shot and killed Corey Durell Ruiz.

body.alt: Family members of Corey Ruiz marching in protest with a crowd of demonstrators
body.caption: Family members of Corey Ruiz join a march to protest his death on July 23, 2026, in Madison, Wisconsin.

body.alt: A growing street memorial with flowers, candles, and signs at the intersection where Corey Ruiz was killed
body.caption: A memorial grows at the intersection of South Baldwin and Williamson Streets where Corey Ruiz was shot and killed by Madison police.

body.alt: A protester raises a clenched fist from a car window on a Madison street
body.caption: A protester raises a fist from a car window on East Washington Avenue in Madison on July 22, 2026, after police killed Corey Ruiz.
